parse_mmcif_string: parse an mmCIF file string into a ParsingResult with structure, header, and chain sequence data
extract_mmcif_loop_to_list: extract mmCIF loop data entries matching a prefix into a list of dictionaries
extract_mmcif_loop_to_dict: extract mmCIF loop data entries matching a prefix into a dictionary keyed by an index column
get_protein_chains: extract polymer information for protein chains only from parsed mmCIF data
get_release_date: get the oldest revision date from parsed mmCIF audit revision history data
